# `and`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Logical AND.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
expr1 and expr2
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented (SQL syntax) |
| Group | `predicate_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- and, example 1
> SELECT true and true;
true
```

```sql
-- and, example 2
> SELECT true and false;
false
```

```sql
-- and, example 3
> SELECT true and NULL;
NULL
```

```sql
-- and, example 4
> SELECT false and NULL;
false
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
